title: lore read-only graph-cache generations block worktree removal fleet-wide (opum-ai/opum-fleet OFLE-339)
description:
Read-only modes on .lore/cache generations leave directories that an EXTERNAL recursive delete cannot remove. Measured fleet-wide by opum-desktop on 2026-10-15; filed against opum-fleet as OFLE-339 (the earlier rm -rf variant is OFLE-320).

REPRODUCTION. Run any lore query (or lore check) in a checkout, then delete the checkout recursively. The cache generation directory .lore/cache/graph/ladybug/<version>/generations/<key> is mode 0555, with index.json 0400 and projection.lbdb 0444 inside, so deleting its contents needs a write bit on the containing directory. git worktree remove deletes the worktree gitfile and then fails partway, leaving a directory with no .git that holds only the lore cache; opum-fleet repo-root guard then refuses to clean an unknown no-.git directory, which is correct.

ANSWER (measured in source at origin/dev ce57b688, 2026-10-19): the modes are DELIBERATE, not incidental. src/core/ladybug-lifecycle.ts:369 seals the database 0444 and :371 seals the generation directory 0555; :766 opens the control manifest 0400 (writeControlManifestLast). ADR docs/adr/0018-persistent-local-graph-projection-with-ladybugdb.md:62 states that generations are immutable and opened read-only. test/ladybug-lifecycle.test.ts:258-260 and :349-351 assert no write bit is set on the generation directory, the database, the control manifest and the published files. The lore removal path already thaws first: removeContained calls makeDirectoryTreeWritable (src/core/ladybug-lifecycle.ts:1003). The defect is therefore that immutability is enforced without an owner-facing way to delete the cache, not that the modes are wrong.

SCOPE: the operator decides through opum-doc between (a) a lore-side fix, for example a lore cache clear / lore clean command (or a lifecycle removal step) that thaws and deletes the tree, and (b) a guard carve-out allowing removal of a no-.git directory that contains only .lore/cache. This task records the defect and the answer only.

HELD: not to be worked before the 0.14.0 pair release lands.
